groundCutout.basis: Original6m standard Mapzen samples include a raised stadium/bowl intrusion. Approximate field datum uses the lower20percent perimeter sample plus0.3m, not the high centre DSM sample; this is a visualization contact fit, not a surveyed excavation or foundation level.
